thread:
maria: Observed reproducible memory growth on long streaming chat sessions with tight tool loops. Repro on dedicated-prod-4 and locally using replay harness. Heap drifts until OOM after ~6-8h.

ajay: Can you paste repro steps and heap top? Curious if this is KV paging/eviction or streaming buffer aliasing.

maria: Repro: run `scripts/repro/long_stream_tool_loop_local.sh` against local runtime :4300. Pattern: every 3rd assistant call -> tool returns ~200-350 tokens. Loop for ~5k iterations. pprof top after 4.5h:
```
(pprof) top
     140MB  31.8% 31.8%  github.com/redwood/infer/kv.(*Cache).Get
     110MB  25.0% 56.8%  runtime.mallocgc
      60MB  13.6% 70.4%  github.com/redwood/infer/serve.(*Session).appendTokens
      28MB   6.3% 76.7%  github.com/redwood/infer/kv.(*Cache).evictLocked
      18MB   4.1% 80.8%  github.com/redwood/infer/kv.(*value).Bytes
```
Heap shows many []byte values with cap >> len under kv values. Suspect we are aliasing reusable streaming buffers into the cache and zero-copy Get keeps big caps alive.

li: What kv config on that cluster? soft/hard limits and eviction policy?

maria: kv_soft_limit=6GB, kv_hard_limit=14GB, eviction=compact-first. TTL 1h but sessions are persistent so TTLs don't help.

noah: If Get returns references to internal buffers, callers holding onto those slices will keep the entire backing array. Also if we Set using a reused scratch buffer (without copying) we retain its full cap.

ajay: Grep for cache.Set(key, buf[:n]) without copying. Also check where Get returns internal slice headers versus copies.

maria: Found several places in stream adapters doing exactly that. Also Cache.Get has a no-copy fast path we added for low latency reads. Combined, long sessions that repeatedly reuse buffers and read them keep caps alive.

li: Two immediate mitigations: (A) defensive copy-on-Get for session-scoped caches when session.meta.streaming==true; (B) per-session kv byte quota + session-aware eviction so long sessions can't pin unlimited bytes.

maria: I prototyped (A) locally: Get does `buf2 := make([]byte, len(v)); copy(buf2, v)` when session.streaming. Stress 6h: before patch OOM ~7h, after patch stable peak ~3.9GB. Microbench: zero-copy Get ~30µs for 2KB values, copy Get ~66µs. End-to-end 95th latency increased ~4% in this streaming scenario.

noah: Good hotfix. For medium-term we need per-session quotas (default 512MB) and eviction policy that prefers evicting oldest entries within a session once quota exceeded. Global LRU lets long sessions keep churned keys marked "recent" and avoid eviction.

ajay: Also fragmentation: repeated varying allocations leave many large caps. Consider shrink-to-fit on aged entries (realloc to len) when they become eviction candidates. This will reduce fragmentation and sometimes return memory to the runtime.

li: For very large tool responses we could consider slab/mmap to allow munmap of large regions. But that's a heavier change. Start with shrink-to-fit + per-session quotas.

maria: Proposed action plan:
1) Hotfix: merge copy-on-get for streaming sessions (PR 5310). Roll out to staging canary.
2) Short: per-session kv_quota default 512MB + session-local eviction LRU. Li to prototype.
3) Medium: eviction compaction: shrink-to-fit and pool small buffers; track fragmentation metric.
4) Long: evaluate slab/mmap path for large blobs.
5) CI: add `ci/stress/kv_long_stream` nightly 6h job to catch regressions.
6) Monitoring/alerts: emit session_kv_bytes, session_kv_entries, kv_fragmentation_estimate. Alert if one session increases session_kv_bytes > 250MB over 2h -> eng-oncall + automatic heap dump.

ajay: Add trace spans when a session triggers eviction so we can correlate to tool loops and traces. Also capture last N traces for that session in the heap snapshot metadata.

maria: Will open the hotfix PR with pprof artifacts and microbench. Also added a runbook draft in `runbooks/kv-memory.md` with repro steps and mitigations.

deploy-bot: deploy-preview: PR 5310 deployed to staging-canary-2 (dp-20260320-17).

maria: Staging canary run 10h stable. Will monitor 48h then promote.

li: I'll take per-session quota prototype, plan to have a design PR by next week with tests and a stress job.

noah: Also audit language connectors (python/java/ruby) for passing large pre-allocated bytearrays into runtime. Add defensive copy at ingress if needed.

maria: Agreed, I'll grep connectors and follow up with PRs to ensure we don't retain external large buffers.

ajay: After hotfix and quota, still prioritize compaction pass to avoid slow accumulation of fragmentation in long-lived clusters.

maria: Scheduling a follow-up design meeting in #eng-runtime-design to pick owners and timelines. Thanks team :thumbsup:
